Signature Ritual

How to use Glow Theory

1

Take the powder

Place a suitable amount of Glow Theory powder in a clean bowl.

2

Mix with water

Add water gradually and mix into a smooth paste.

3

Use during your bath

Apply gently as part of your regular bathing routine.

4

Rinse well

Rinse thoroughly and continue with your normal routine.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Glow Theory?

Glow Theory is The Root Theory's Herbal Sanam Bath Powder, created around a traditional-inspired botanical bathing ritual.

What pack sizes are available?

The prototype presents 100 g, 250 g and 500 g formats with the displayed prices.

How do I place an order?

Add your preferred item to the cart, review the cart, complete the checkout details and proceed to the selected payment option.

Will online payment be integrated?

The checkout and payment interface is included visually in this prototype. The actual payment gateway can be connected in the next phase.

How can I contact The Root Theory?

Customers can contact the brand through WhatsApp, phone, email or Instagram.
